review: Love the restaurant choice but the payment page froze twice before my order went through.
Tracking my rider on the map is brilliant, super easy.
Checkout takes forever, too many steps just to pay for a burger.
I can't find my old orders anywhere. Where is the order history?
Delivery took over an hour and the food was cold.
Simple, clean app. Ordering is quick.
Would be great if I could reorder my usual meal with one tap.
Payment keeps failing with my card, had to try 3 times.
Good app overall but delivery fees are too expensive.
The app crashes when I open my previous orders.
